# Lab 7.10: Build a BigQuery Pipeline

## What We Are Going to Do
Chain a SQL query, a data preparation and a notebook into one pipeline, and run it end to end.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Create the pipeline.** In Studio click **+ → Pipeline** (or **Pipelines and connections → Create → Pipeline**). Name it `lab07_pipeline`.

2. **[Console] Add a SQL task.** Click **Add task → Query**. Paste:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab07.orders_last_30d AS
SELECT * FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.orders`
WHERE created_at &gt;= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Add the data preparation.** Click **Add task → Data preparation** and pick the one from Lab 7.9. Set it to run after the query task.

4. **[Console] Add a notebook task.** Click **Add task → Notebook → New notebook**. In the first cell:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">%%bigquery
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS n FROM lab07.orders_last_30d GROUP BY status</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Set it to run after the query task.

5. **[Console] Configure and run.** Open **Pipeline settings**: pick a **service account** and a **Cloud Storage bucket** for notebook output. Click **Run**. Watch each task turn green in the graph.

6. **[CLI] Confirm the outputs.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq query --use_legacy_sql=false 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab07.orders_last_30d'
gcloud storage ls -r gs://$PROJECT_ID-bq-labs/ | grep -i ipynb | head</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Tasks | Query, data preparation, notebook |
| Order | Dependencies shown as a graph |
| Engine | Pipelines run on Dataform |
| Notebook output | Saved to your bucket |
